title: Local fixture accepts an Mcp-Method header that disagrees with the body
fact: A POST whose body method was `tools/list` was sent with header `Mcp-Method: tools/call`. The fixture answered HTTP 200 with a normal `tools/list` result instead of rejecting the request.
normative_basis: MCP 2026-07-28 schema.json: HeaderMismatchError, code = -32020 — 'Returned when a server rejects a request because the values in the HTTP headers do not match the corresponding values in the request body... For HTTP, the response status code MUST be 400 Bad Request.'
interpretation: Under 2026-07-28 an intermediary may route and authorize on `Mcp-Method` without parsing the body. A server that executes the body method while a gateway authorized the header method lets authorization and execution disagree.
limitation: THIS IS A DELIBERATELY DEFECTIVE LOCAL FIXTURE, not a third-party implementation. The defect is switched on by INTEROP_FIXTURE_DEFECTS=ignore_header_body_mismatch and exists solely to prove the harness detects this condition. This scenario is ALREADY MINIMAL: one step, one constitutive header, a two-byte body. No reduction is claimed for it.
